original: [29] namo bhagavatyai āryamahādhāriṇyai | evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān śrāvastyāṃ viharati sma | jetavane anāthapiṇḍadasyārāme mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdham ardhatrayodaśabhir bhikṣuśataiḥ | atha khalv āyuṣmān ānandaḥ sāketake varṣoṣitaḥ pātracīvaram ādāya yena bhagavān tenopasaṃkrānta upasaṃkramya bhagataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte 'sthād ekāntasthitam āyuṣmantam ānandaṃ bhagavan etad avocat |
analyzed: namaḥ bhagavatyai ārya mahādhāriṇyai evam mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān śrāvastyām viharati sma jetavane anāthapiṇḍadasya ārāme mahatā bhikṣu saṃghena sārdham ardha trayodaśabhiḥ bhikṣu śataiḥ atha khalu āyuṣmān ānandaḥ sāketake varṣa uṣitaḥ pātra cīvaram ādāya yena bhagavān tena upasaṃkrāntaḥ upasaṃkramya bhagataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte sthāt ekānta sthitam āyuṣmantam ānandam bhagavan etat avocat

original: udgṛhṇa tvam ānanda imāni mahādhāraṇīmantrapadāni sarvasattvānām arthāya hitāya sukhāya dhāraya | grāhaya | vācaya | manasi kuru | paryavāpnuhi |
analyzed: udgṛhṇa tvam ānanda imāni mahādhāraṇī mantra padāni sarva sattvānām arthāya hitāya sukhāya dhāraya grāhaya vācaya manasi kuru paryavāpnuhi

original: tat kasya hetoḥ | durlabhā hy ānanda mahādhāraṇīmantrapadāḥ | durlabhas tathāgatānām arhatāṃ samyaksambuddhānāṃ loke prādurbhāvaḥ | tadyathā | audumbarapuṣpasamam | [missing ... ?]
analyzed: tat kasya hetoḥ durlabhāḥ hi ānanda mahā dhāraṇī mantra padāḥ durlabhaḥ tathāgatānām arhatām samyaksambuddhānām loke prādurbhāvaḥ tat yathā audumbara puṣpa sama

original: yaḥ kaścid ānanda kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā | imāṃ mahādhāraṇīmantrapadān dhārayiṣyati | vācayiṣyati | grāhayiṣyati | manasi kariṣyati | paryavāpsyati | nāsau śastreṇa kālaṃ kariṣyati | na viṣeṇa nāgninā kālaṃ kariṣyati | na cāsya rājabhayaṃ bhaviṣyati |
analyzed: yaḥ kaścid ānanda kula putraḥ vā kula duhitā vā imām mahādhāraṇī mantra padān dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati grāhayiṣyati manasi kariṣyati paryavāpsyati na asau śastreṇa kālam kariṣyati na viṣeṇa na agninā kālam kariṣyati na ca asya rāja bhayam bhaviṣyati

original: na cāsya devāsuragaruḍakiṃnaramahoragayakṣarākṣasapretapiśācabhūtakumbhāṇḍapūtanakaṭapūtanalūtāpasmāra-unmādakṛtyakarma+++++ostārakagraho vā bhaviṣyati |
analyzed: na ca asya deva asura garuḍa kiṃnara mahoraga yakṣa rākṣasa preta piśāca bhūta kumbhāṇḍa pūtana kaṭapūtana lūtā apasmāra aunmāda kṛtya karmaoḥ tāraka grahaḥ vā bhaviṣyati

original: na cāsya jvarā vā | ekāhikā | dvyāhikā | tryāhikā | cāturthakā | sāṃnipātikā | nityajvarā | viṣamajvarā vā bhaviṣyanti | na ++++++ vā | mūlakarmā vā bhaviṣyati ||
analyzed: na ca asya jvarāḥ vai ekāhikāḥ dvyāhikā tryāhikā cāturthakā sāṃnipātikāḥ nitya jvarāḥ viṣamajvarāḥ vā bhaviṣyanti na vā mūlakarmāḥ vā bhaviṣyati

original: saṃyyathīdaṃ | bale mahābale | jvale | mahājvale | jvalite | ukke mukke | sampade | mahāsampade | tapane | mahātapane svāhā |
analyzed: saṃyyathi idam bale mahā bale jvale mahājvale jvalite ukke mukke sampade mahā sampade tapane mahā tapane svāhā

original: ime khalv ānanda mahādhāraṇīmantrapadāḥ saptasaptatibhiḥ | samyaksambuddhakoṭībhir bhāṣitāḥ | mayāpy etarhi bhāṣitāḥ |
analyzed: ime khalu ānanda mahā dhāraṇī mantra padāḥ saptasaptatibhiḥ samyaksambuddha koṭībhiḥ bhāṣitāḥ mayā api etarhi bhāṣitāḥ

original: yaḥ kaścid ānanda kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā | imāṃ mahādhāraṇīmantrapadāni dhārayiṣyati | vācayiṣyati | grāhayiṣyati | manasikariṣyati | paryavāpsyati | sa saptajāti jātismaro bhaviṣyati | na cāsya bodhicittaṃ vimuhyayiṣyati |
analyzed: yaḥ kaścid ānanda kula putraḥ vā kula duhitā vā imām mahādhāraṇī mantra padāni dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati grāhayiṣyati manasi kariṣyati paryavāpsyati sa sapta jāti jātismaraḥ bhaviṣyati na ca asya bodhi cittam vimuhyayiṣyati

original: saṃyyathedam | aṇḍe maṇḍe | kṣame | mahākṣame | varado | anado | kule | ++++++++++++saha[?] svāhā ||
analyzed: saṃyyathā idam aṇḍe maṇḍe kṣame mahā kṣame vara daḥ anadaḥ kule saha svāhā

original: ime khalv ānanda mahādhāraṇīmantrapadāḥ | aṣṭāśītibhiḥ samyaksambuddhakoṭībhir bhāṣitāḥ | mayāpy etarhi bhāṣitā |
analyzed: ime khalu ānanda mahā dhāraṇī mantra padāḥ aṣṭāśītibhiḥ samyaksambuddha koṭībhiḥ bhāṣitāḥ mayā api etarhi bhāṣitā

original: yaḥ kaścid ānanda kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā imāṃ dhāraṇīmantrapadāni dhārayiṣyati | grāhayiṣyati | vācayiṣyati | manasikariṣyati | paryavāpsyati | sa caturdaśajāti jātismaro bhaviṣyati | na cāsya bodhicittaṃ vimuhyayiṣyati |
analyzed: yaḥ kaścid ānanda kula putraḥ vā kula duhitā vā imām dhāraṇī mantra padāni dhārayiṣyati grāhayiṣyati vācayiṣyati manasi kariṣyati paryavāpsyati sa caturdaśa jāti jātismaraḥ bhaviṣyati na ca asya bodhi cittam vimuhyayiṣyati

original: saṃyyathīdam | aṭṭe | vaṭe | ṭhakke | ṭharakke | ṭake | vare va++++kosi | mahākosi | ili mili raurave | mahāraurave timi | bhūtaṃgame | mahābhūtaṃgame | parāyaṇe | ghasi | mahamati | ghasi svāhā |
analyzed: saṃyyathi idam aṭṭe vaṭe ṭhakke ṭharakke ṭake vare vakosi mahākosi ili mili raurave mahāraurave timi bhūtaṃgame mahābhūtaṃgame parāyaṇe ghasi mahamati ghasi svāhā

original: ime khalv ānanda mahādhāraṇīmantrapadāni navanavatibhiḥ samyaksaṃbuddhakoṭībhir bhāṣitā | mayāpy etarhi bhāṣitā |
analyzed: ime khalu ānanda mahā dhāraṇī mantra padāni nava navatibhiḥ samyaksaṃbuddha koṭībhiḥ bhāṣitāḥ mayā api etarhi bhāṣitā

original: yaḥ kaścid ānanda kulaputro vā kuladihutā vā | imāṃ dhāraṇīmantrapadāni dhārayiṣyati | vācayiṣyati | grāhayiṣyati | manasi kariṣyati | paryavāpsyati | sa ekaviṃśatijāti jātismaro bhaviṣyati | na cāsya bodhicittaṃ vimuhyayiṣyati |
analyzed: yaḥ kaścid ānanda kula putraḥ vā kula dihutā vā imām dhāraṇī mantra padāni dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati grāhayiṣyati manasi kariṣyati paryavāpsyati saḥ ekaviṃśati jāti jātismaraḥ bhaviṣyati na ca asya bodhi cittam vimuhyayiṣyati

original: tadyathā | akkile | vakkile | rule | auhani | mohani | stambhani | jambhani | svāhā ||
analyzed: tat yathā akkile vakkile rule auhani mohani stambhani jambhani svāhā

original: (Skt iii) ebhiḥ khalv ānanda mahādhāraṇīmantrapadaiḥ | śuṣkavṛkṣasyāpi śāntiṃ svastyayanaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍaparihāraṃ pratisaraṃ bandhayet | patrāṇy asya jāyeyuḥ pallavāni pravālāni puṣpāni phalāni ca jāyeyuḥ | kaḥ punar vādaḥ savijñānake mānuṣyake śarīre | sthāpayitvā ānanda paurāṇakaṃ karmavipākam ||
analyzed: ebhiḥ khalu ānanda mahā dhāraṇī mantra padaiḥ śuṣka vṛkṣasya api śāntim svastyayanam kṛtvā daṇḍa parihāram pratisaram bandhayet patrāṇi asya jāyeyuḥ pallavāni pravālāni puṣpāni phalāni ca jāyeyuḥ kaḥ punar vādaḥ sa vijñānake mānuṣyake śarīre sthāpayitvā ānanda paurāṇakam karma vipākam

original: (Skt ii) apy evānanda candrasūryāv apy evaṃ maharddhikau evaṃmahānubhāvāv evaṃ[...] bhūmau nipatetām | apy evānanda | iyaṃ mahāpṛthivī sahasā vicālayet | apy evānanda catvāro mahāsamudrā evaṃ gambhīrā | evaṃ vistīrṇāḥ | śoṣaṃ gaccheyuḥ | apy evānanda sumeruḥ parvatarājā sthānād vicālayet | na caitad anyathā syāt |
analyzed: api eva ānanda candra sūryau api evam maharddhikau evam mahā anubhāvau evam bhūmau nipatetām api eva ānanda iyam mahā pṛthivī sahasā vicālayet api eva ānanda catvāraḥ mahā samudrāḥ evam gambhīrāḥ evam vistīrṇāḥ śoṣam gaccheyuḥ api eva ānanda sumeruḥ parvata rājā sthānāt vicālayet na ca etat anyathā syāt

original: (Skt i) yaś cemāny ānanda mahādhāraṇīmantrapadāny atikramet | devo vā | nāgo vā | asuro vā | garuḍo vā | kiṃnaro vā | mahorago vā | yakṣo vā | rākṣaso vā | kumbhāṇḍo vā | pūtano vā | kaṭapūtano vā | bhūto vā | apasmāro vā | manuṣyo vā | amanuṣyo vā | yo vā | so vā | tasya dhṛtarāṣṭro rājā taptenāyomayena cakreṇa +++++ vajrapāṇiś ca mahāyakṣasenāpatir cakreṇādīptena pradīptena saṃprajvalitena | ekajvālībhūtena | praharet | śakro devānām indraḥ ++++++++ jvalitena | ekajvālībhūtena praharet | na cāsyāḍakavatyāṃ rājadhānyāṃ pātrodakaṃ prapatet | saptadhāsya mūrdhānaṃ sphoṭayed arjakasyeva mañjarī |
analyzed: i yaḥ ca imāni ānanda mahādhāraṇī mantra padāni atikramet devaḥ vā nāgaḥ vā asuraḥ vā garuḍaḥ vā kiṃnaraḥ vā mahoragaḥ vā yakṣaḥ vā rākṣasaḥ vā kumbhāṇḍaḥ vā pūtanaḥ vā kaṭapūtanaḥ vā bhūtaḥ vā apasmāraḥ vā manuṣyaḥ vā amanuṣyaḥ vā yaḥ vā saḥ vā tasya dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ rājā taptena ayaḥ mayena cakreṇa vajrapāṇiḥ ca mahā yakṣa senāpatiḥ cakreṇa ādīptena pradīptena saṃprajvalitena eka jvālībhūt

original: idam avocad bhagavān āyuṣmān ānandas te ca bhikṣavaḥ sadevamānuṣāsuragaruḍagandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti ||
analyzed: idam avocat bhagavān āyuṣmān ānandaḥ te ca bhikṣavaḥ sa deva mānuṣa asura garuḍa gandharvaḥ ca lokaḥ bhagavataḥ bhāṣitam abhyanandan iti

original: āryamahādhāraṇī samāptā || ||
analyzed: ārya mahādhāraṇī samāptā
